coll.noFields: No fields inferred (the collection is empty or unsampled).
coll.noSecondary: No secondary indexes. The `_id` field is always indexed.

common.name: Name
common.prodWarning: This is a **production** connection. Review carefully.

props.autoLocked: {label} can only be set when the column is created on this engine.
props.codecHint: How this column is compressed, e.g. Delta, ZSTD(3) for a timestamp, or ZSTD(1) for text. Empty uses the server's default.
props.columnNeedsType: Column "{name}" needs a type. The grey text is a suggestion, not a value.
props.columnNull: An auto-increment column is never null.
props.createFirst: Create the table first, then add indexes.
props.defineFirst: -- Define a table name and at least one column.
props.engineFixed: A ClickHouse table's engine, sort key and partitioning are the order its data is written in, so they cannot be changed here. Open the **Storage** tab to see what this table is, its partitions, its projections and its skip indexes.
props.generatedDefault: The generated value is the default.
props.keepRowsHint: Partitions whose whole range is older than this are dropped by SnoutTime's worker. Empty keeps everything.
props.layout: How the data is laid out
props.noPkTick: No primary key. Tick PK on a column to add one.

nullablePk.one: {columns} allows NULL, so the key also sets NOT NULL. It fails if any existing row is null there.
nullablePk.other: {columns} allow NULL, so the key also sets NOT NULL. It fails if any existing row is null there.

props.partitionHint: A partition is read and dropped as a unit. A month of a timestamp column is the usual answer; too many partitions is worse than none.
props.partitionSizeHint: How much time one partition holds. A day suits most tables; aim for partitions of a few million rows.
props.pkFixed: This engine fixes the primary key when the table is created: changing it means rebuilding the table and copying the rows.
props.replicasHint: This server has {count} replicas. The table is created `ON CLUSTER` with a `Replicated` engine, so every replica has it and they keep each other up to date.
props.sealAfterHint: How long after a partition's range ends it is compressed into the column store. Late writes still land after it.
props.seriesExplain: SnoutTime partitions it by time and makes partitions ahead of the data. Old partitions are sealed into a compressed column store and dropped when they pass the retention. Queries and writes do not change.
props.seriesMoveRows: Rows already in the table move into their partitions in the background.
props.seriesSummary: Partitioned by **{column}**, {size} per partition, {partitions} partitions{sealed}. The time column and partition size are fixed once a series exists.
props.snouttimeOff: SnoutTime is off in this database
props.snouttimeOffHint: Switch it on to partition this table by time, seal old partitions and keep rollups. It takes effect at once, with no restart, and only in this database.
props.sortKeyHint: Tick the key columns in **Columns**. This is the order the rows are stored in, and what a query can skip data by.
props.sortKeyTitle: The columns ticked as the key in Columns. It is the order the rows are stored in, which is what a query skips data by.
props.ttlHint: When a row expires and is removed.

tele.bloatHint: dead / (live + dead); vacuum if it climbs.
tele.dataFreeHint: Free space inside the data file (reusable, not returned to the OS).
tele.noHistory: No history matches `{table}`. Run a query against it to populate this list.
tele.rowsHint: Approximate row count from the catalog (not an exact COUNT).
